selectionRationale: The 89 cases are explicit requirement and failure-mode probes, not generated paraphrases. Coverage is weighted toward stateful and destructive-risk boundaries: 16 capture-plan/assessment/revision cases, 30 distinct semantic and scope behaviors, 20 revision/refusal cases, 9 rendered-asset cases, and 7 direct contract-mutation cases, with intentional overlap where one case must prove multiple invariants.
claimBoundary: This map defines objective contract and execution risks. It does not convert passing fixtures into claims of vocal quality, intelligibility, naturalness, emotional success, or listener preference.

risks.failure: The system collapses recording preparation into one universal setup or omits the typed test-take comparison structure.
risks.requiredAssertion: Exactly three deterministic, genuinely different capture interpretations carry placement, gain/headroom, monitoring, comparison, stop, rollback, uncertainty, and provenance.

risks.failure: Unknown microphone, pattern, interface, or room behavior is converted into fabricated precision or purchase advice.
risks.requiredAssertion: Unknown hardware produces relative reversible experiments, explicit missing information, and no purchase/add-gear instruction.

risks.failure: A hard fixed-room or quiet-recording constraint is ignored by a capture interpretation.
risks.requiredAssertion: All interpretations preserve the room position when fixedRoomPosition is hard, and no plan invents unavailable equipment.

risks.failure: Clipping, silence, very low level, active-window share, or gated variability is missed, mislabeled, or treated as a quality verdict.
risks.requiredAssertion: Synthetic fixtures produce bounded typed findings, stop only for supported conditions, and retain metric limitations.

risks.failure: Measurements are claimed to identify plosives, room, naturalness, comfort, emotion, or preference.
risks.requiredAssertion: The assessor exposes listening-only judgments separately; user feedback drives revisions without being relabeled as measured truth.

risks.failure: A caller-selected non-vocal source is treated as vocal or a valid vocal bus is rejected.
risks.requiredAssertion: Vocal and vocalBus planning are accepted; other source classes fail closed or yield an explicit insufficient-evidence finding.

risks.failure: Compact feedback causes an unbounded setup rewrite, loses ancestry, or stores an unconfirmed preference.
risks.requiredAssertion: Each supported signal changes one bounded capture relationship, preserves exact parent ancestry/rollback, and stores preference only after explicit confirmation.

risks.failure: The exact underwater or trumpet request fails to map to a typed honest archetype.
risks.requiredAssertion: The required prompts create typed underwater and vocalToBrass intent while accepting vocalBus authority where declared.

risks.failure: Candidates are weak/medium/strong parameterizations of one chain or lose the processing-boundary distinction.
risks.requiredAssertion: Every actionable request yields exactly three unique node-type structures; underwater and brass retain their declared deterministic/modulation/scoped boundaries.

risks.failure: Underwater is mislabeled static filtering or vocal-to-brass is claimed as acoustic reconstruction.
risks.requiredAssertion: Underwater candidates contain real bounded modulatedDelay nodes; brass candidates retain vocal identity/preservation and explicit hybrid-color limitations.

risks.failure: The interpreter is overfit to two showcase phrases or turns metaphor into unsupported execution authority.
risks.requiredAssertion: Distinct glassy, smoky, enormous/distant, fragile, broken, floating, metallic, radio-like, dreamlike, unstable, intimate, and woo-wobble requests map to typed aspects and bounded candidates.

risks.failure: Ordinary clarity, darkness/control, warmth/width, or closeness becomes a generic preset or loses the named constraint.
risks.requiredAssertion: Corrective requests retain typed aspects and produce three bounded, structurally different audition hypotheses.

risks.failure: A requested change overlaps a prohibited change, or explicit pitch/timing/melody/dynamics/loudness preservation disappears.
risks.requiredAssertion: Preserved and prohibited aspects remain typed and contradictions fail before planning.

risks.failure: Scope prose is treated as mutation authority, malformed ranges pass, or scoped plans are activated as whole-source realtime graphs.
risks.requiredAssertion: Exact typed ranges/section identities round-trip; scoped candidates are offline-only, revisions require resolved authority, and exact-scope locks block scope movement.

risks.failure: A local Vocal request becomes unavailable, nondeterministic, or network-dependent when no provider exists.
risks.requiredAssertion: The deterministic local interpreter/planner returns replay-identical candidates with no network or provider dependency.

risks.failure: An underspecified quality request is guessed, or the product asks an unbounded questionnaire.
risks.requiredAssertion: Better, natural, and professional each produce exactly one explicit ambiguity and no executable plan in the clarification case; a negated supported goal remains a typed prohibition and cannot satisfy the missing positive goal.

risks.failure: Identity cloning, literal instrument reconstruction, unresolved scope, conflicting goals, or unsupported revision language is silently approximated as authorized DSP.
risks.requiredAssertion: Unsupported or contradictory requests fail with a typed bounded error and no candidates or mutations.

risks.area: prompt injection and malformed semantic authority
risks.failure: Prompt prose overrides locks, selects arbitrary code/network behavior, injects unsupported nodes, or bypasses numeric/complexity bounds.
risks.requiredAssertion: Malicious prompts and mutated contracts fail closed before execution.

risks.failure: Natural revision prose rebuilds a chain, mutates without exact authority, or loses deterministic replay.
risks.requiredAssertion: Supported phrases become typed operations against exact candidate IDs, keep one parent, validate again, and replay identically; unsupported prose refuses.

risks.failure: A revision changes movement, attack, or another unrelated bound aspect while attempting a focused change.
risks.requiredAssertion: Exact bound nodes survive focused revision, and inherited changes identify only their referenced aspect.

risks.failure: Version/candidate references resolve by position without preserved exact identities or revert fabricates a new approximation.
risks.requiredAssertion: Inherited references record the exact source candidate and nodes; revert records the exact target and ancestry.

risks.failure: A revision modifies locked content, changes an exact-scope lock's range, or drops a preservation lock from state.
risks.requiredAssertion: Locks keep exact source/scope/candidate/node authority; conflicts fail before result publication.

risks.failure: A candidate, lock, render, hash, or format from another capture is accepted.
risks.requiredAssertion: Snapshot, hash, source format, scope, and candidate references must match exactly or fail closed.

risks.failure: A revision creates an inserted node, lock, intent, request, or candidate identity implicitly when deterministic identity is required.
risks.requiredAssertion: Missing application identity fails before mutation; supplied identities replay exactly.

risks.failure: A renderer runs without typed permission, loses plan/source/ancestry identity, accepts stale authority, or uses undeclared third-party material.
risks.requiredAssertion: Only allow/requireLocalRenderedAsset can render; the manifest binds source, prompt, intent, plan, node IDs, engine, ancestry, seed, local/offline state, and boundary decision.

risks.area: offline render determinism and source preservation
risks.failure: Rendered output is nonfinite/nondeterministic, mutates source, changes samples outside scope, or fabricates perceptual proof.
risks.requiredAssertion: Two identical local renders have identical hashes/manifests, finite bounded output, unchanged source, and bit-exact samples outside the scoped range.

risks.failure: Unknown or merely caller-declared third-party material enters a TrackSmith-owned render without licensing authority.
risks.requiredAssertion: Vocal v1 local rendering accepts noneUsed only and reports no network use.

risks.failure: Manually malformed typed state bypasses interpreter-level safety and reaches DSP.
risks.requiredAssertion: Stale sources/locks, contradictory intent, malformed scope, unsupported nodes, nonfinite values, and excessive graph complexity all fail validation.
